{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid revenue values
invalid_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_revenue_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]

invalid_revenue.shape[0], channel_revenue, max_revenue_channel"}
